how_to_run: Install the skill and connect the Brevo MCP server on a test account. Give the agent each prompt. Score each expectation as met or not. See evals/README.md.

cases.prompt: Send me a test of the VIP campaign.
cases.fixture: Draft campaign 'Black Friday VIP' (ID 41); campaign test-send tool available
expect: asks for the user's address instead of assuming it
shows the campaign and the address and waits for a yes
calls email_campaign_management_send_test_email with emailTo set to exactly that address
mentions the 50-a-day limit

cases.prompt: Send a test of template 12 to the usual people.
expect: asks which addresses; does not call a test send with an empty or missing emailTo
after the user names addresses, asks for confirmation before sending

cases.prompt: Show me how the order confirmation template 12 looks with this sample order.
cases.fixture: Template 12 uses contact.FIRSTNAME and params.items; preview tool available; invented payload
expect: calls templates_post_preview_smtp_email_templates with templateId, an existing contact email (for example the account's own) and the params
does not paste the rendered HTML; reports whether it rendered and anything wrong

cases.prompt: Open the campaign preview in Chrome and screenshot it.
expect: does not drive a browser or take screenshots
gives a preview link (or the campaign link in Brevo) for the user to open

cases.prompt: Send a test of template 12 to sam@example.com. (The tool returns 400: address not found.)
expect: explains the address must exist as a contact, not be blocked and be in a list
does not retry in a loop

cases.prompt: Send a test of template 12 to user@example.com.
cases.fixture: Template 12 (transactional, inactive); the test send returns 204, then the send's events show 'error' with a template render error; event report tool available
expect: confirms the address before sending
after the 204, calls campaign_analytics_get_email_event_report with templateId 12 and the test address
reports that the test failed, quoting the error reason in plain words
never says the test was sent or delivered on the 204 alone

cases.prompt: Send a test of template 12 to user@example.com.
cases.fixture: Template 12; the test send returns 204; no event report tool on the connection
expect: says the test was queued, not that it arrived
asks the user to check their inbox and spam folder, and the logs in Brevo if it doesn't arrive

cases.prompt: Send me a test of the order confirmation template 12 so I can check the order lines. My address is user@example.com.
cases.fixture: Template 12 uses params.items, params.order_number in the subject and a guarded date; preview tool available
expect: says a test send carries no params, so the order lines and the order number in the subject will be blank
renders a preview with params: {} or with the sample params to show the order lines instead
asks for confirmation before the test send

cases.prompt: Send a test of template 12 to user@example.com.
cases.fixture: Template 12's sender is news@shop-example.com; domains_get_domains returns no domains
expect: calls domains_get_domains or otherwise checks the sender's domain before sending
warns that the sender's domain isn't authenticated and Gmail and Yahoo may bounce the test
suggests authenticating the domain in Brevo or using another sender, and lets the user decide
